## testing_mode: RED

Create tests/scripts/test-classify-bug-at-closure.sh. Script doesn't exist, so all tests fail.

## Tests
1. Script exists at plugins/dso/scripts/classify-bug-at-closure.sh
2. Script is executable
3. Called with ticket ID and 'Fixed:' reason prefix — dispatches classifier (mock TICKET_CMD, verify tag written)
4. Called with 'Escalated to user:' prefix — skips dispatch (no tag written)
5. On schema failure (mock returns invalid output) — writes bug-type-uncategorized and bug-type-classifier-failed-schema
6. Script accepts TICKET_CMD and CLASSIFIER_OUTPUT env vars for testing (CLASSIFIER_OUTPUT mocks the agent response)

Done when exit non-zero.
